g.text: quarter end. ANT: only one monthly close (IPO 19 Nov 2026). Negative or missing TTM EPS plotted as N/M, not a negative multiple. Sources: Webull (prices, income statements); Yahoo Finance TWD=X for TSM FX. Research, not advice.
